title: Questions to Ask a Guy to Get to Know Him: 110 Great Picks
h1: Questions to Ask a Guy to Get to Know Him: 110 Fun, Interesting and Deep Picks
description: 110 questions to ask a guy to get to know him, from easy icebreakers to fun hypotheticals and deeper questions, plus tips for keeping it natural.
keyword: questions to ask a guy to get to know him
excerpt: 110 questions to ask a guy to get to know him, sorted from light icebreakers to imaginative hypotheticals and meaningful deep talks.
intro:
Getting to know someone new is one of the best parts of dating, and one of the most nerve-racking. You want the conversation to flow, you want to learn who he really is, and you definitely don't want it to feel like a job interview.

The right questions make all of that easier. Below are 110 questions to ask a guy to get to know him, sorted by mood: easy icebreakers, questions about his life and background, interesting ones, playful hypotheticals, deeper questions and a few about relationships. Start with a quick read of the tips on using them, then pick the ones that feel natural for where you two are.
body:
How to use these questions naturally

A great question opens a door; what you do next decides whether you walk through it. Keep these tips in mind:

  • Follow up. The best conversations come from the second question: 'What made you choose that?' or 'What was that like?'
  • Share too. Answer your own questions so it's a swap, not an interrogation.
  • Match the moment. Light questions suit a first chat or a busy bar. Save deeper ones for quieter moments when you both feel comfortable.
  • Let him pass. If a question touches something he'd rather not discuss yet, move on easily.
  • Don't run down a list. Pick two or three that interest you and let the conversation wander.
Tip: Over text, send one question at a time and add your own answer. 'Okay, important question: best breakfast food? Mine is chilaquiles, no debate' feels playful instead of formal.

Easy icebreaker questions

  1. What's the best thing that happened to you this week?
  2. How do you usually spend a perfect Saturday?
  3. What are you watching or reading right now?
  4. Are you a morning person or a night owl?
  5. What's your go-to coffee or drink order?
  6. What song have you had on repeat lately?
  7. What's your favorite way to unwind after a long day?
  8. Cats, dogs, both or neither?
  9. What's the best meal you've had recently?
  10. Do you have a favorite spot in this city?
  11. What's a hobby you could talk about for hours?
  12. Beach vacation or mountain cabin?
  13. What's something that always puts you in a good mood?
  14. What's the last thing that made you laugh out loud?
  15. Do you cook? What's your signature dish?
  16. What's an app you couldn't live without?

Questions about his life and background

  1. Where did you grow up, and what was it like?
  2. What were you like as a kid?
  3. What did you want to be when you grew up?
  4. Who were you closest to in your family growing up?
  5. What's a family tradition you love?
  6. What's your favorite childhood memory?
  7. How did you end up in the job you have now?
  8. What's the best part of your work?
  9. Who has been the biggest influence on your life so far?
  10. What's something you learned the hard way?
  11. Who's your oldest friend, and how did you meet?
  12. What's the best place you've ever traveled to?
  13. What's a moment you're really proud of?
  14. What's the bravest thing you've ever done?
  15. Is there a decision you made that changed the direction of your life?
  16. What's a skill you picked up that surprised people?

Interesting questions to ask a guy

  1. What's a topic you could give a 20-minute presentation on with zero prep?
  2. What's an unpopular opinion you'll defend?
  3. What's something you've changed your mind about in the last few years?
  4. What's the most interesting thing you've learned recently?
  5. Which three people, living or historical, would you invite to dinner?
  6. What's a small thing that makes you irrationally happy?
  7. What's on your bucket list that might surprise people?
  8. If you could master any skill overnight, what would it be?
  9. What's a book, movie or show that changed how you see things?
  10. What's the strangest job you've ever had?
  11. What's a compliment you've never forgotten?
  12. Which fictional character do you relate to most?
  13. What's a smell that instantly takes you back somewhere?
  14. What's something most people don't know about you?
  15. What's your weirdest talent?
  16. What's your guilty-pleasure song?
  17. What would your friends say is your best quality?
  18. What's the best advice anyone has ever given you?

Fun hypothetical and fictional questions

  1. If you could live inside any movie or book world, which would you pick?
  2. You get one superpower, but it only works on Tuesdays. Which do you choose?
  3. If you were a character in a heist movie, what would your role be?
  4. If you could time travel once, would you go to the past or the future?
  5. What would your walk-up song be if you were a baseball player?
  6. If animals could talk, which one would be the rudest?
  7. If you opened a restaurant, what would be on the menu?
  8. You win the lottery tomorrow. What's the first thing you buy?
  9. If your life were a TV show, what would the title be?
  10. Which fictional villain do you secretly think had a point?
  11. If you could swap lives with someone for a day, who would it be?
  12. Would you rather explore the deep ocean or outer space?
  13. If you were stranded on an island, which three items would you bring?
  14. If you could be famous for one thing, what would it be?
  15. What would your perfect day look like if money and time didn't matter?
  16. If you could have dinner with your future self, what would you ask?
  17. Which zombie apocalypse role would you play: leader, medic, scout or comic relief?
  18. If you had to teach a class on anything, what would it be?

Deep questions to ask a guy

  1. What does a meaningful life look like to you?
  2. What are you most grateful for right now?
  3. What's something you're working on improving about yourself?
  4. When do you feel most like yourself?
  5. What's a fear you've overcome?
  6. What's a fear you're still working through?
  7. What does friendship mean to you?
  8. How do you usually handle stress?
  9. What's something you wish people understood about you?
  10. What's a value you'd never compromise on?
  11. What's the hardest thing you've ever been through, if you're comfortable sharing?
  12. What makes you feel truly appreciated?
  13. Where do you see yourself in five years?
  14. What's a dream you've never said out loud?
  15. How have you changed in the last five years?
  16. What does success mean to you?
  17. What's a lesson your parents taught you that you still live by?
  18. When was the last time you cried, and why?

Want to go deeper with a partner? Try our list of deep questions to ask your boyfriend.

Questions about love and relationships

  1. What's your idea of a perfect date?
  2. What's the most romantic thing you've ever done for someone?
  3. How do you like to show someone you care?
  4. What makes you feel loved?
  5. What's something you learned from a past relationship?
  6. What qualities do you value most in a partner?
  7. Do you believe in love at first sight?
  8. What's a relationship you admire, and why?
  9. How important is alone time to you?
  10. What's a dealbreaker for you?
  11. How do you handle disagreements with someone you're close to?
  12. What's your love language, if you know it?

Light questions for texting

  1. What's the highlight of your day so far?
  2. Send me the last photo you took that you're allowed to share.
  3. What's your current comfort show?
  4. Rate your day out of ten. Explain your scoring.
  5. What are you having for dinner tonight?
  6. What's something you're looking forward to this week?
  7. Pizza toppings: what's your controversial order?
  8. What's the best meme you've seen this week?
  9. Describe your mood with a movie title.
  10. What's a random fact you know that nobody asked about?
  11. If you could teleport anywhere right now, where would you go?
  12. What's playing in your headphones right now?

For more ways to keep things flowing, see how to start a conversation with a guy over text and our list of things to talk about with your crush.

Reading his answers

Questions do more than fill time. His answers, and how he responds, tell you a lot. Does he ask questions back? Does he seem curious about you? Is he comfortable being a little vulnerable, or does he joke away every serious question? Neither style is wrong, but they give you a sense of how he connects.

Also notice what lights him up. The topics he talks about with real energy are the ones to come back to later. And if he remembers what you told him on your next conversation, that's a lovely sign. For more clues, check out signs he likes you or browse all our question lists.

Tip: If a question lands flat, don't panic. Laugh it off, share your own answer and switch to something lighter. Smooth recoveries are part of a good conversation.

The bottom line

The best questions to ask a guy to get to know him are the ones you're genuinely curious about. Start light, follow up, share your own answers and go deeper as trust builds. Whether you're on a first date, texting a new match or years into a relationship, good questions keep you learning about each other, and that's what keeps a connection alive.
takeaways: Start with light icebreakers and save deeper questions for quieter, comfortable moments.
Follow-up questions matter more than the first question.
Share your own answers so it feels like a conversation, not an interview.
Pay attention to what lights him up and whether he asks questions back.

faq.q: What are good questions to ask a guy you just met?
faq.a: Stick with easy, open-ended questions: how he spends his weekends, what he's watching or reading, his favorite spot in town or the best thing that happened this week. These are friendly and low pressure, and they give you plenty to follow up on. Save personal or heavy questions for when you know each other better.

faq.q: What are deep questions to ask a guy?
faq.a: Deep questions explore values, dreams and experiences, such as what a meaningful life looks like to him, what he's working on improving, what makes him feel appreciated or how he's changed in recent years. Ask them in a calm, private setting, share your own answers and let him skip anything he isn't ready to discuss.

faq.q: How many questions should I ask on a date?
faq.a: There's no set number. Focus on a few good questions with thoughtful follow-ups rather than a long list. Aim for a back-and-forth rhythm where you both share. If it starts to feel like an interview, pause your questions and tell a story of your own.

faq.q: What questions should you not ask a guy early on?
faq.a: Early on, avoid questions about salary, detailed questions about his past relationships, his views on marriage and kids or anything that feels like an evaluation. These topics matter, but they're better saved for when you've built some trust. Let them come up naturally as the relationship grows.
